ENGLISH: The Egyptian government has sent us a proposal. They say that our defeat at the hands of Cappadocia has put us in a dangerous position, and that with their help we can turn the tide. They have offered help in gaining us control over all of Anatolia in return for us pledging ourselves to them, and becoming their pawn.

The Greek Terror has finally been defeated! After 6 long years of war we have finally defeated them, and they have fully surrendered to us. We have realized the dream of the late Sultan Suleyman I, and have brought glory to our nation. Now the time has come to consolidate our new lands, and ensure that they stay belonging to us.

Despite the valiant attempt of our army and the young Sultan Osman II, we have sadly been defeated by the Greeks. A stain on our young Sultans reign, and a disgrace to the legacy of his father Suleyman I. While all is not yet lost, we must consider why it was that we lost the war, and prepare ourselves for the future. The Sultanate of Rum will not go quietly into the night!

For 5 years now we have been in a state of war with Cappadocia, and this is only a small part of a long history of conflict between our two nations. The famine and devestation they experienced 10 years ago has them weak, and ill prepared for our might. We could finally seize all of Anatolia, with the might of our armies and shrewd mind of our great Sultan. This is the start of a new age, the age of Rum!

The City of Constantinople has defied our demands! They have responded that they would sooner die than let themselves be ruled by "some cutthroat Turkic mongrel." They dishonor themselves with their words and actions, we tried to avoid further bloodshed in a conflict that has already been decided. Alas, we are left with no choice.

The Queen of Cities, the Heart of the Empire, the City of the World's Desires, Constantinople, has surrendered to us. Today our troops marched into the city, proudly waving the banner of Rum. The Kingdom of the Greeks has finally been defeated, and we can now claim their prized possesion.

Yesterday the world grew silent. The Queen of Cities and City of the World's Desires, Constantinople, fell to Turkic forces. The blue and white banner of Rum now flies above the Hagia Sofia. Anatolian and Levantine troops patrol the street, and the Hagia Sofia has been closed for the foreseeable future. Today is a dark day in the history of Greece, and marks the dawn of a new era.

The Albanian people have risen up in rebellion against the Bulgar state. They have declared a popular Albanian general as king, and have sent us a request for aid. They propose a strong relationship and a partition of Macedonia. What should we do?

The Albanian revolution is triumphant! With our help they have won, and the Bulgar state has been forced to recognize their independence. However, this independence will always be under threat from other powers in the region. That is why we must ensure their continued existence by forming a closer relationship between our two states, we will gain their loyalty in return for protecting them with our armies.

At 9 PM yesterday, the nation received tragic news. Sultan Osman II passed away, surrounded by his family, close friends, and most loyal of ministers. The Sultan was hard at work until his last moment, coordinating policies with his ministers and discussing tax reforms. No matter what one thinks of the late Sultan, he was undeniably a man commited to his country. His son and heir, Sultan Mehmed the Third, will be crowned in the days to come. It is hard to say what the young sultan will accomplish, but his fathers legacy will surely weigh hard on his every action.
